messages.content: ekta situationship e achi, define kora nai kichu, ki korbo bujhtechi na
Undefined thaka comfortable lagche naki confuse lagche beshi? Karon eta depend kore next step ta ki hobe.
confuse beshi lagche, ami clarity chai
Tahole ekbar shoja jigges kore dekho ora ki chai. Awkward lagte pare, jani, kintu clarity na thakle situation ta emni e continue korte thakbe - amar mote sheta beshi kosto dey.
